If you are a current Fort Bend County employee (excluding election workers): Please click here to apply through the internal Workday Jobs Hub. If you cannot access the Jobs Hub, please contact Human Resources. 


 Fort Bend County is ranked as one of the fastest growing counties in the nation.  We have capitalized on not only the creed of our location, but on the "quality of life" for our families to call home.  Our employees are the key to our success and the heartbeat of our foundation.  The diversity and inclusivity of our community is our strength and at the forefront of a workplace environment welcoming to all.  Live Here! Work Here! 
 
 
 Implements and maintains website content within a content management product.  
 Maintains and coordinates the utilization of content management software and develops/documents content standards.   
 Trains users, sets up security, reviews and enforce standards with all content. 
 Researches new web features and tools.  
 Provides first level support on website/intranet issues. 
 
 
 MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS :

 High school graduate. Some college experience preferred.  
 Experience with HTML, cascading style sheets (CSS), scripting, familiarity with web accessibility standards; experience with developing and maintaining website content.
 1 year experience with web development preferred. 
 Set schedule of 30-40 hours per week. 
 

 SALARY: $25.00 per hour, 30-40 hours per week
 DURATION OF ASSIGNMENT: Up to approximately March 31, 2027 
 CLOSING DATE: Upon filling position

 THIS IS A TEMPORARY POSITION AND THERE ARE NO BENEFITS INCLUDED. 
  
All full-time and part-time employees are members of the Texas County District Retirement System (TCDRS). Full-time employees also enjoy a wide-range of great benefits.
